title: Open and close the Settings tab, the palette and Settings on Accounts in a narrow window, zooming the window around the Settings tab
preconditions: a fresh launch: one 800 x 900 pt window, one workspace, one terminal tab, no overlay

steps.note: Settings… (openSettings): Settings opens as a session-local page tab of the focused pane (SettingsWindowService.show), selected; no window opens. The tabs facet lists page and browser tabs only, so its panes go from none to this one (topology tab_count counts daemon tabs, not this one)
Zoom: the window grows to the screen while the Settings tab shows
Zoom again: the window returns to its 800 pt frame with the Settings tab still selected
Cmd-W closes the selected tab, the Settings tab; the terminal tab is selected again
Command Palette: a layer of the overlays facet's stack, above the narrow window
Palette: Clear or Close, the action Escape runs in the open palette (PaletteKeyMap): with an empty query it closes the palette; debug.key would reach the shell window, not the palette panel
Accounts… (AccountsHandlers: settingsWindow.show(section: .accounts)): the Settings tab opens again, on its Accounts section
Cmd-W closes the Settings tab again

invariants: while Settings or Accounts shows, the focused pane's selected tab is a page tab of page settings in the main window, and the window list has the one window: Settings is a tab, not a window
after each Cmd-W the Settings tab is gone, the terminal tab it was opened over is selected again and the focused pane is the one the window had
the window's frame is the screen's width at settings-wide and returns to its launch fraction after unzoom; the Settings tab stays selected through both zooms
the palette is a layer of the overlays facet's stack while it shows, and the stack is empty again after dismiss-palette
no step changes a setting: the settings facet at closed-all equals the launch's
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
the turn checkpoint of each key step is a prefix of its settled checkpoint (I3)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: the profile menu: it is an NSMenu in tracking, which the overlays facet does not list, and debug.key's Escape goes to the shell window, not the menu's tracking loop (actions/sidebar/_tuning.json, sidebar.profileMenu)
the notifications panel: a child NSPanel of the window (NotificationsPanelController), which the overlays facet does not list (actions/misc/_tuning.json, showNotifications)
click hints: hints.show is unavailable while labs.previewFeatures is off, as in the oracle launch, and the hint labels are a subview, not an overlays facet layer
outside dismissal by a click: the app driver has no pointer step
the update surface: Check for Updates… reaches the update feed over the network, and oracle cases run offline
the overlays' own controls: the ax suite (tests/oracle/corpus/ax/overlays-and-settings-*.json) records them at three widths
